findings: Portal and low warm shell/coral banks anchor the entrance; its return has rebalanced plants and coral banks.
Rose plate corals frame the second stop; the near portal pillar no longer occupies its center.
The third stop has the tall sea-feather meadow and overhead manta/shoals.
The fourth stop shows cool angular reef walls and narrow coral silhouettes.
The fifth stop is a concentrated umbrella coral grove with the original Moon Arc moved aside.
The final overlook highlights pale gold fan coral; its return has layered banks and coral foreground.
budget: 42 reefs, 9 sea fans, 288 fish, 512 plant tufts retained; giant corals reduced from 14 to 10; 1770 mesh instances versus 1786 in 01.1.
limitations: Open water is intentionally simple and some distant rock shapes remain similar.
The fifth return retains a close umbrella crown partly framing the top of the view.
Physical phone, other GPU performance and user subjective acceptance remain untested.
userAcceptance: Pending actual experience on the user usual device; no claim of approval.
